title: Metal-free synthesis of tricyclic benzofuro[2,3-c]pyridin-3-ol derivatives, characterization, and photoluminescence properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31840-31852
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05420F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Surbhi Mahender Saini, Sandeep Chandrashekharappa
This paper presents a metal-free synthetic protocol for assembling novel benzofuro[2,3-c]pyridin-3-ols (BFPYOLs) using 2,3-disubstituted benzofuran derivatives and their photoluminescence properties.
